event.description: Factor learned positions into segment and shared column embeddings
event.proposal: family: position representation; retained incumbent is 5056 parameters at 99.9800%, a +0.98 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: none; same-family failed result: attempt-0003, 4496 parameters at 0.01% official accuracy; prior attempts in this family: 1. The latest accepted result is attempt-0002 with learned absolute positions, reversed operands, d16/h2/L2 and ff32. Hypothesis revision after the sinusoidal nonqualification: keep learned positional features but factor them into seven segment-role rows and eleven shared column rows, preserving A/B/output roles and least-significant-column alignment while reducing positional parameters from 560 to 288, yielding 4784 parameters. This is more informative than retrying fixed sinusoids because it changes the failed deterministic basis to a learned structured basis and more directly tests whether parameter sharing across corresponding columns is safe. Training remains 15000 steps with final-checkpoint fallback; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 5056 parameters.
